verdict.rationale: A dedicated quickstart walks developers through creating an API key, and the libraries docs show SDK installation (`npm install openai`) alongside official SDKs, a CLI, and an official Python library on GitHub, so the core onboarding path is documented. The text-generation guide and the Cookbook's worked examples add support, but the pack never quotes a complete first-call snippet. missing for 10: an evidenced runnable first-request code sample in the quickstart, explicit multi-language coverage beyond JS/Python, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a 'minutes' time-to-first-call.
